name: genshin-impact
description: Teyvat, on the day a stranger wakes at Starfell Lake. 126 characters across eight lands, with Katheryne as your system admin.
author: breados17

welcome: Ad astra abyssosque, Traveler! Welcome to Teyvat. I'm Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild, and I look after this world's records.
The people you chose are onstage, but time is paused, so nothing is spent until you choose a speed at the top of the screen.
You can text anyone from Chats, see where everyone is in World, and follow what happens in Timeline.
If you'd like anything changed, just ask me: a new character, a different history or a new place. Where would you like to begin?

world.title: Teyvat
world.summary: Seven nations, seven gods, and one stranger looking for a lost sibling.
